final: WITH rating_groups AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / NULLIF(replacement_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_group_ratio FROM rating_groups) SELECT g.rating, g.avg_ratio, g.film_count, g.avg_ratio - o.avg_group_ratio FROM rating_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_group_ratio IS NOT NULL
